title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper MANS: Efficient and Portable ANS Encoding for Multi-Byte Integer Data on CPUs and GPUs
problem: Artifact reproducibility verification for SC25 paper on ANS (Asymmetric Numeral Systems) encoding efficiency and portability.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative requires artifact evaluation and author verification of scientific claims.
method: A committee member independently ran the MANS paper's code to verify its experimental results. They tested whether ANS encoding (Asymmetric Numeral Systems—a compression technique for multi-byte integers) actually achieved the efficiency gains reported on both CPUs and GPUs. They verified the code was truly portable, working correctly on both hardware types.
key_novelty: Independent verification confirmed that the MANS paper's ANS encoding achieves its claimed efficiency and portability across CPUs and GPUs.
contributions: Reproducibility verification of ANS encoding efficiency claims
Assessment of portability across CPU and GPU platforms
limitations: Reproducibility report (meta-analysis); only summarizes artifact evaluation, not original contribution
